prompt: The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Most people maintain that the construction of high-rise buildings is the most feasible solution to combat housing shortages in large cities. I totally agree with the statement because it can minimise land usage and provide an easy-to-access location for urban residents.

One of the main advantages of vertical urbanisation is that it needs a lot less land to mount tall buildings. As a result, it can provide enough accommodation for the increasing urban population , but also affordable housing to large populations. Provided that only urban sprawling is possible, property pricing in the city would skyrocket. To illustrate it, a survey conducted by the Thai government in 2025 shows that a majority of the urban population chose to live in apartments due to the fact that a large investment was not necessary in accommodation.

Another merit is that it can save commuting time for the urban population. The main reason why most people opt for living in cities is that they can provide all amenities without having to travel long distances. As basic infrastructure such as hospitals, schools, and universities are within reachable distance, it can ease the strain on them regarding transportation. To illustrate it, a survey conducted by a real estate agent in Yangon shows that most apartment hunters prefer an easy-to-access location where not only commercial spaces such as malls and shopping centres but also recreational and sports centres , including a public swimming pool and a gym, are available.

To conclude, I completely concur with the view that constructing tall apartments is the most effective strategy to tackle the issue of not enough accommodation in urban areas because it does not need much space , and it can also provide convenience for residents.
